visual_review.review_scope: All contact-sheet thumbnails were visually inspected by class. No obvious out-of-class images, people, readable personal information, labels, or prominent third-party marks were observed. This is a contact-sheet review, not a full-resolution rights review of every image.

pedagogy.task: Classify seven indoor-plant image categories and compare common confusions and class counts.
pedagogy.use_case: Explore whether an image-based guide can help a student distinguish common indoor plants.
limitations: Photos were collected at one agricultural corporation and nearby nurseries in Bangladesh, according to the publisher.
The official page says agronomists confirmed class labels; the artifact does not independently validate botanical identity.

Sequential photos and similar views may remain related across train/validation/test. The time-ordered split reduces adjacent-shot mixing but is not a test of performance on different homes, cameras, or specimens.
Do not use to infer plant toxicity, disease, health, or care requirements.

changes: Resized JPEG images from 3000x3000 to 512x512 and re-encoded at quality 0.86.
Removed EXIF and Photoshop/IPTC metadata; 1,159 source images contained GPS tags.
Created chronological per-class train/validation/test splits with approximate 70/15/15 proportions.

artifact.artifact_validation: passed with cvlesson pinned-format and safe-extraction validator

rights.rights_review: Official Mendeley v1 landing page displays CC BY 4.0. No embedded documents were included. Contact-sheet visual review found no obvious people or visible personal information. This does not establish separate rights for every photographed object or botanical identity.
